_source: CMS HHS-HCC V28 Risk Adjustment Model. Coefficient values derived from CMS CY2025 Medicare Advantage Final Rate Announcement (April 2024), Table VI-2 'Relative Factors for Community and Institutional Beneficiaries under the 2024 CMS-HCC Model (Version 28)', available at https://www.cms.gov/files/document/2025-announcement.pdf. Demographic coefficients from Attachment VI of the same document. Verified against hccinfhir open-source library (https://github.com/pfehlinger/hccinfhir) which transcribes the same CMS-published coefficient tables verbatim. All expected values computed by summing published V28 coefficients directly (no blending, no MACI, norm_factor=1.0) so they pin the raw hccinfhir output.
_note: norm_factor=1.0, maci=0.0, model_version=CMS-HCC Model V28. Expected values are pre-normalization raw scores (risk_score from hccinfhir). Tolerance 0.0001 unless overridden.

cases.description: Community Non-dual Aged 70M, diabetes without complications — low-risk floor case
cases.source_note: CMS V28 CNA segment. Demo: CNA_M70_74=0.396 (CMS CY2025 Rate Announcement Table VI-2). HCC 38 (Diabetes w/ Glycemic/No Complications, ICD E11.9): CNA coefficient 0.166 (same table). Sum=0.562.

cases.description: Community Non-dual Aged 75F, metastatic cancer to lung — high-risk
cases.source_note: CMS V28 CNA segment. Demo: CNA_F75_79=0.465 (Table VI-2). HCC 17 (Cancer Metastatic to Lung/Liver/Brain, ICD C78.01): CNA coefficient 4.209 (Table VI-2). Sum=4.674.

cases.description: Community Non-dual Aged 80M, CHF + diabetes — mid-risk, hierarchy non-collapsing combo
cases.source_note: CMS V28 CNA segment. Demo: CNA_M80_84=0.571 (hccinfhir CNA table; CMS Table VI-2 CY2025 Rate Announcement). HCC 226 (End-Stage CHF, ICD I50.22): CNA coefficient from hccinfhir CNA table. HCC 38 (DM no complications, E11.9) coeff 0.166. CHF+DM are in different HCC families — no hierarchy collapse. total_raf=1.209 verified by running hccinfhir directly.

cases.description: Community Non-dual Aged 65F, no diagnoses — pure demographic floor
cases.source_note: CMS V28 CNA segment. Demo: CNA_F65_69=0.330 (Table VI-2). No disease score. Purpose: regression trip-wire confirming demo score applied even with zero diagnoses.

cases.description: Community Full-dual Aged 75F, COPD — dual-eligible CFA segment
cases.source_note: CMS V28 CFA segment. Demo: CFA_F75_79=0.596 (hccinfhir CFA table, from CMS Attachment VI). HCC 280 (COPD/Emphysema, ICD J44.9): CFA coefficient 0.390. Sum=0.986. Validates that dual-eligible coefficient table is selected when segment=CFA.

cases.description: Community Full-dual Aged 80M, diabetes with complications + CKD stage 4 — dual eligible high-complexity
cases.source_note: CMS V28 CFA segment. ICD N18.4 → HCC 327 (CKD stage 4 in V28 hccinfhir mapping). ICD E11.40 → HCC 37 (Diabetes with Chronic Complications; E11.40=DM with diabetic neuropathy unspecified). HCC 37 and HCC 327 are in separate hierarchy chains. Both must survive in dual-eligible CFA segment. total_raf=1.540, demo=0.789 verified by running hccinfhir directly.

cases.description: Institutional 80M, CHF + DM — validates INS coefficient table selection
cases.source_note: CMS V28 INS (Institutional) segment. ICD I50.22 → HCC 226. ICD E11.9 → HCC 38. INS coefficients differ from community per CMS Table VI-2. Both HCCs must survive (different hierarchy families). Validates prefix_override=INS_ propagates to engine.

cases.description: Community Non-dual Disabled 55M, no diagnoses — under-65 disabled floor
cases.source_note: CMS V28 CND segment (under-65 disabled). Demo: CND_M55_59=0.283 (hccinfhir CND table, derived from CMS Attachment VI disability segment table). Disease score = 0.0. Regression gate for CND segment routing.

cases.description: Community Non-dual Disabled 45F, morbid obesity — disabled under-65 with HCC
cases.source_note: CMS V28 CND segment. ICD E66.01 → HCC 48 (Morbid Obesity). CND HCC 48 coefficient from hccinfhir CND table. Demo: CND_F45_54 from disability coefficient table. Validates HCC scoring in under-65 disabled segment.

cases.description: Community Non-dual Aged 70F, DM with complications (HCC 37) collapses DM no-complications (HCC 38)
cases.source_note: CMS V28 HCC hierarchy: HCC 37 (Diabetes with Chronic Complications) trumps HCC 38 (Diabetes with Glycemic/No Complications). ICD E11.40 → HCC 37 (DM with diabetic neuropathy unspecified). ICD E11.9 → HCC 38. After hccinfhir hierarchy enforcement, only HCC 37 should remain. Verified by running hccinfhir: ['E1140','E119'] -> hcc_list=['37']. Source: CMS HCC hierarchy file V28 2024, chain: 37 > 38.

cases.description: Community Partial-dual Aged 68F, breast cancer — partial dual eligible (CPA segment)
cases.source_note: CMS V28 CPA segment. ICD C50.911 → HCC 23 (Breast, Prostate, Colorectal, and Other Cancers and Tumors in V28 hccinfhir mapping). CPA coefficients from hccinfhir CPA table. Validates partial-dual segment routing separate from full-dual CFA. total_raf=0.568, demo=0.365 verified by running hccinfhir directly.

cases.description: Community Non-dual Aged 72M, morbid obesity only — single low-HCC case
cases.source_note: CMS V28 CNA segment. Demo: CNA_M70_74=0.396. HCC 48 (Morbid Obesity, ICD E66.01): CNA coefficient 0.186 (Table VI-2). Sum=0.582. Low-risk, single HCC, no interactions — baseline regression for HCC 48 coefficient stability.
